extras.approval_status: APPROVED by project owner 2026-08-28, per plan.md decision D7. Core coalition facts (government_groups_citation below) approved as-drafted.

government_groups_citation.claim: Plzeň's 2022-2026 governing coalition, formed after the Oct 2022 election, is ANO 2011 a nezávislí (2nd place, 15/47 seats) + Piráti/Česká pirátská strana (4/47) + STAN (4/47) + PRO PLZEŇ (5/47) — 28/47 seats, a clear majority. The 'Spolu' coalition list (ODS+KDU-ČSL+TOP09) won the most seats (15/47) but sits in OPPOSITION, not government. Roman Zarzycký (ANO) became primátor (mayor); first deputy mayor for technical affairs is Pavel Bosák (Piráti), deputy for school/tourism is Lucie Kantorová (ANO), deputy for transport/environment is Aleš Tolar (STAN). The new 11-member Rada města Plzně was presented 2022-10-11 and elected at the constitutive ZMP session 2022-10-18.

Corroborated directly by the vote data itself: the term's very first roll-call vote (2022-10-18, point 98555, 'Volba primátora města Plzně...') shows exactly this same set of people voting together, and the current (2026-08-28) headcount per klub from plzen/data/memberships.csv matches the reported election seat counts almost exactly (ANO 15, ODS 9, PRO PLZEŇ 5, SPD 4, Česká pirátská strana 4, STAN 4, KDU-ČSL 3, TOP 09 3 = 47 total), after 4 years of term churn — a strong internal-consistency signal, same kind of cross-check used for every prior city.
sources: plzen/data/memberships.csv (this repo's own derived data) — internal source-data citation, not an external news claim

extras.not_investigated: Whether ANO/Piráti/STAN/PRO PLZEŇ's own internal composition changed (e.g. a faction split) is out of scope, matching every prior city's equivalent note — this repo models each source-reported klub as one org, no sub-party split available. Also not investigated: whether the 'Spolu' list's 3-way split (era1 -> era2/3) reflects a real change in coalition/opposition alignment for those 15 people, or just a labeling change within the SAME opposition status — treated here as still-opposition throughout, since no citation suggests otherwise.
